standard_prerequisites.name: The group H_1(N, f_bullet) is defined as cycles of the form (x_1, ..., x_n) with f_i x_j = f_j x_i modulo Koszul boundaries, per the explicit Ext lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the cycle and boundary description the computation acts on.

core_obligations: A class in H_1(N, f_bullet) is represented by a tuple (x_1, ..., x_n) with f_i x_j = f_j x_i (proof line 24463). Multiplying by f_i gives f_i(x_1, ..., x_n) whose entries f_i x_j equal f_j x_i, i.e. the coordinates of the tuple built from x_i (proof lines 24463-24464), which is a Koszul boundary. Hence f_i annihilates the class, and since i was arbitrary and the f_i generate I, the ideal I annihilates H_1(N, f_bullet) (proof line 24465).
proof_roadmap: Represent a class by a Koszul 1-cycle (x_1, ..., x_n) (proof line 24463).
Multiply by f_i and recognize the product as a boundary via f_i x_j = f_j x_i (proof lines 24463-24465).
difficulty_reason: 5 行、Koszul H_1 被 I 零化：1-闭链 (x_1,…,x_n) 满足 f_i x_j = f_j x_i；乘 f_i 后各分量 f_i x_j = f_j x_i 恰为 Koszul 边缘，故 [f_i·(x_1,…,x_n)] = 0；f_i 任取且生成 I，得 I 零化 H_1。承重计算全在 span 内；statement 里 1 处引用（H_1 的定义出处）作导航桩。
